spread_checks.note: Guards against a silently corner-blind harness: if every corner returns the same vref, the .lib/.temp injection is not taking effect. design/bias_core.md's own spot check already found a ~9.7 mV vref spread across process x temperature alone (1.2477-1.2574 V), so this bound is well inside what a working harness should observe.
